sentences.text:
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KAILASH PRASAD DEO -------
 For the Appellant : Mr. Alok Lal, Advocate

For the Respondents :
 --------
The matter is being taken up through Video Conferencing.
Learned counsel for the appellant has no objection with it and submitted that audio and video qualities are good.
Order No.04 /Dated: 08th May, 2023 Heard, learned counsel for the appellant Mr. Alok Lal.

The National Insurance Company Limited has preferred this miscellaneous appeal against the award dated 02.06.2018 passed by learned Presiding Officer, Motor Vehicles Accident Claims Tribunal,
Ranchi in Motor Accident Claim Case No.297 of 2011, whereby the claimants 1. Sunita Devi, W/o Late Dev Kumar Sharma, 2. Nawendu Kumar, S/o Late Dev Kumar Sharma, 3. Neha Kumari, D/o Late Dev Kumar Sharma, 4. Usha Kumari, D/o Late Dev Kumar Sharma, all permanent resident of Village-Norhi, P.S.-Arki, District-Khunti, presently residing at Village-Bundu Patra Toli, P.O. & P.S.-
Bundu, District-Ranchi, 5. Bishambhar Hajam @ Bishambhar Sharma, S/o Late Tahal Hazam and 6. Thakur Mani Devi, W/o Sri Bishambhar Sharma, both 5 & 6 permanent resident of Village-Norhi,
P.S.-Arki, District-Khunti, presently residing at Village-Bundu, Patra Toli, P.O+P.S.-Bundu,
District- Ranchi have been awarded compensation to the tune of Rs.29,67,050/-(after deducting Rs.50,000/-, which has already been paid under Section 140 of the M.V. Act) without interest,
though the Insurance Company has been given right of recovery from the owner of the offending vehicle.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant, Mr. Alok Lal has submitted, that Insurance Company has only aggrieved, as the income of the deceased namely Dev Kumar Sharma, who used to purchase and sale of Mahuwa, Paddy etc. from local hat Bazar at his house.

The learned Tribunal has considered the income of the deceased on the basis of document brought on record for the Financial Year 2009-10 Divisional Manager vs Sunita Devi & Ors on 8 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39096530/
1 (Assessment Year 2010-11), which has been marked as Ext.-10 without testing the genuineness of the document as it has been verified in the year 2018 and that too the signature of officer is missing on it, as such the learned Tribunal has wrongly exhibited the same and relied upon the same for assessing the income of the deceased.

entities.text: Divisional Manager vs Sunita Devi & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant, Mr. Alok Lal has further submitted, that there is doubt about the income of the deceased and the same has been raised in para-18 of the written statement filed by the Insurance Company.

Learned counsel for the appellant, Mr. Alok Lal has further submitted, that I.A. No.10982 of 2018 has been filed for condonation of the delay of 87 days in preferring the appeal.
This Court has perused the impugned award, it appears that the deceased namely, Dev Kumar Sharma died in a road accident on 23.11.2010 at about 07:30 P.M., when offending vehicle Truck bearing Registration No.JH-05AB-9265 dashed the deceased from behind, resulting into his death on the spot.

It it admitted fact that deceased was doing the work of purchase and sale of Mahuwa, Paddy etc., he died on 23.11.2010 and prior to his death he has filed his return for the Financial Year 2009-10 (Assessment Year 2010- 11) and for financial year 2008-09 (Assessment Year 2009-10).
Those documents have been brought on record and marked as Ext.-10 and Ext.-10/1 without any objection from the Insurance Company.

Though the Insurance Company has raised such issue in the their written statement at para-18 but no evidence contrary to the evidence adduced by the claimants has been brought on record nor the claimants were cross-examined in this regard and in the appellate court, such question has been raised by the appellant-Insurance Company, that signature of the officer is not on the paper and what was necessity for verification of the return in the year 2018, which was filed for Financial Year 2009-10 (Assessment Year 2010-11).
This Court is not inclined to entertain such submissions of the appellant-Insurance Company, on the ground that no question has been raised with regard to filing of the I.T.R for the Financial Year 2009-10 (Assessment Year 2010-11) in right time.
If the return has been filed in right time, then its assessing cannot be blamed.

Apart from that the delay in verification may be for two reasons, that Income Tax Department has delayed or it was only the need of the claimants after death of the deceased to get it verified, so that it may be placed before the learned Tribunal.

The appellant-Insurance Company has never raised doubt with contrary evidence about genuiness of the return, which has been marked as Ext.10 and Ext.-10/1 and thus the same have been exhibited without objection.
Raising such issue before this Court in miscellaneous appeal is not sustainable in the eyes of law, as such this Court is not inclined to interfere with the impugned award.

Since the right of recovery has already given in favour of the Insurance Company to recover the same from the owner of the offending vehicle, the right remains with the Insurance Company in Divisional Manager vs Sunita Devi & Ors on 8 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39096530/
2 absence of any appeal preferred by the owner of the offending vehicle, accordingly the miscellaneous appeal is hereby dismissed.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: I.A. No.10982 of 2018 for condonation of delay is also dismissed.
The Insurance Company is directed to indemnify the award within 60 days as the accident is of dated 23.11.2010 and more than 12 years have already been elapsed.

The statutory amount deposited by the Insurance Company at the time of preferring the appeal shall be remitted to the learned Tribunal/learned Executing Court, so as to indemnify the same to the claimants and if, it is found in excess of the awarded amount paid by the Insurance Company, the same shall be returned to the Insurance Company.
(Kailash Prasad Deo, J.) Rohit/-
